svg.title: Our Layered design gives booking its own operation
svg.desc: MVC maps form to command Binding errors and redirects remain in presentation Transactional service validates command Use injected Clock for the future-date check Service loads Owner and selects its Pet Do not use a form-supplied entity as proof of membership Create one Visit, attach it and save Owner Retain the existing JPA cascade structure Transaction interceptor completes commit Only then does the controller receive success

g.text: Our Layered design gives booking its own operation
Binding errors and redirects remain in presentation
Use injected Clock for the future-date check
3. Service loads Owner and selects its Pet
Do not use a form-supplied entity as proof of membership
4. Create one Visit, attach it and save Owner
Retain the existing JPA cascade structure
Only then does the controller receive success
Successful flow when the service owns the outermost transaction. Error branches are omitted.
